$comment: Vectors for the amount_major transform (spec/03-manifest-dsl.md#field-transforms): converts a signed integer minor-unit amount to a major-unit decimal string, using the exponent for `currency` from exponents.json. amount_major is exact and involves no rounding: the exponent fixes the decimal point position, it never divides a value that doesn't land on it. Every runtime's amount_major implementation must match every case here byte-for-byte.

cases.description: Negative amount (refund/reversal): sign is preserved, never dropped
Amount under one major unit still pads to full exponent width
Zero-exponent currency: minor units equal major units, no decimal point
Three-decimal-place currency, sub-unit amount pads to full width
